content.title: Speaking Test 13 — Skills and learning
content.description: The full three-part interview: your work or studies in Part 1, a long turn on “Describe a useful skill you learned outside school or university”, then a discussion of learning new skills and education and employment.

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's talk about your work or studies.

Are you working or are you a student at the moment?
What do you enjoy most about your work or your studies? [Why?]
Is there anything you find difficult about it? [Why/Why not?]
What would you like to be doing in five years' time? [Why?]
Describe a useful skill you learned outside school or university.
bulletsHtml: how long it took you to learn
and explain why this skill has been useful to you

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's consider learning new skills.

Why do some people find it difficult to learn something new as adults?
Is it better to learn a practical skill from a teacher or on your own?
Do you think schools teach enough practical skills?

Let's consider education and employment.

How important are qualifications when people apply for a job?
Do you agree that experience matters more than education?
Should employers pay for their staff to train in new skills?
